properties.Scheme: Anicut and Canal of Mahakumbura Yaaya
properties.Observation: Although the anicut is in good condition, it is unable to collect water due to bank erosion. The canal has also been developed. 6 acres of paddy is cultivated from this canal. Leakages are observed (along the canal). Canal bund has been encroached at some places therefore farmers requested to strengthen the bund and demarcate the reservation by planting Arecanut trees.
